heroSummary: CCS's approved 2027–28 calendar lists Wednesday, August 11, 2027, as the first student day and Thursday, May 25, 2028, as the last. Fall Break is October 11–15, Thanksgiving Break is November 24–26, Winter Break is December 20–January 3, and Spring Break is April 3–7. CCS has not yet published 2027–28 late-start or building rotation schedules.

customSections.label: CCS Approved the 2027–28 Calendar on April 29, 2026
customSections.content: The Carmel Clay school board approved the 2027–28 and 2028–29 calendars at the same meeting. Current in Carmel reported that CCS received responses from more than 2,500 parents and 600 staff members. More than 60% of responding families preferred a weeklong Fall Break, and ending before Memorial Day was another recurring preference.

customSections.label: What Changes from CCS 2026–27 to 2027–28?
customSections.content: The two calendars keep a Wednesday opening and a full-week Fall Break, but every major date shifts.

customSections.label: Late Starts and Color-Day Calendars Come Later
customSections.content: The approved district calendar covers the major school-year dates. CCS publishes late starts, Carmel High School Blue/Gold days, and middle-school color-day rotations separately through its live school calendars. Those 2027–28 schedules have not been published yet, so this page does not carry forward the 2026–27 rotation dates.

calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The Carmel Clay school board approved the 2027–28 calendar on April 29, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Are 2027–28 CCS late-start and Blue/Gold dates available yet?
calendarFaqs.a: Not yet. CCS has published the annual district calendar, but the 2027–28 late-start, Carmel High School Blue/Gold, and middle-school color-day schedules are not yet available on the live school calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: Are return dates after 2027–28 school breaks confirmed?
calendarFaqs.a: Not yet. The approved calendar confirms the break ranges, but CCS has not published the future staff and live school calendars needed to verify when students return after each break.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for 2027–28 calendar updates?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official CCS District Calendar page and your child's live school calendar. Those sources will carry future staff dates, late starts, building events, and color-day schedules when CCS publishes them.
